premises.text: Male fertility is declining and male factors drive a large share of couple infertility, so men should test and freeze sperm
premises.evidence_span: All men should be thinking about freezing and testing their sperm

premises.text: Clinic-based sperm testing and freezing is awkward and clinical, blocking consumer adoption
premises.evidence_span: the experience today is so awkward and clinical of going to a clinic to do it

premises.text: At-home kit with discrete packaging, deposit cup, and buffering medium keeps the sample viable for pickup and clinic processing
premises.evidence_span: a buffering medium that helps keep the deposit viable for up to 48 hours

premises.text: Partner clinics test, analyze, freeze, and run a post-thaw motility check with a personalized fertility report
premises.evidence_span: we do what's called a post-thaw motility check to make sure that the sample is still viable

premises.text: GTM targets men via employers offering fertility benefits, DTC to professionals, and indirect outreach to partners
premises.evidence_span: We also go direct to consumer. We target men in professional services for the most part

premises.text: Offer is about 10% of egg-freezing cost and can be done at home

value.text: Men get a consumer-friendly way to test and freeze sperm at home
value.evidence_span: Legacy is the first company focused on the consumer experience of testing and then freezing men's most valuable assets
